measurement_source: Before is base_commit. After is that base plus this commit's allocation-reuse implementation, before integration of later specification changes (including the independent immutable-reaching-set optimization and verifier/checker changes). These isolated percentages must not be added to the independent Webs measurements. Both emitters were built before timing; after production sources were frozen for all measured runs.
decision: Retain search-local bounded reuse of identical allocation proposals; ordinary candidate admission and validation policies are unchanged. No verdict or source authority is reused by this cache.
scope: Compiler emission only, including checking, native candidate search, verification, C-source and native-object writing. No C compilation, linking or application-runtime timing. Existing faster full-unroll BLAKE3 output is preserved, not made faster at runtime by this patch.

platform.limitations: Shared host busy with other work; no compiler builds/tests from this experiment overlapped measurements. Light read-only inspection and documentation work occurred during timings. Host load was not sampled per run; wall-time variability is substantial. No confidence bounds or universal wall-time speedup claim.

protocol.execution: Separate sequential non-overlapping emitter processes with distinct output prefixes; before and after emitters reused unchanged across scopes.
protocol.validation: cmp verified identical .o and .c across all four BLAKE3 runs and separately across both seven-kernel runs. BLAKE3 freshly Proven for all eight chunks every run; 0 of 1 verdicts from cache. Seven-kernel runs each reported 0 of 12 verdicts from cache; evidence grades were unchanged.
protocol.cpu_definition: Total CPU seconds = user + system; CPU can exceed elapsed time due to Go parallel work.
protocol.memory_definition: Maximum resident set size from time -l is process memory, not retained cache size. Cache PayloadBytes counts canonical input plus output, not Go heap.

blake3.final_verdict_all_four: native backend: asm unit hash__blake3_ucompress: proven equal to its Oak body (the same term on both sides) (all 8 result chunks)
blake3.recipe_label_note: before2 reported late-cleanup in addition to full unrolling, scheduling and reallocation; output bytes were identical in all four runs.
blake3.interpretation: Paired total CPU reductions are 73.55% and 74.99%, with approximately 75% fewer retired instructions. Elapsed reductions are observed but uncontrolled. RSS rises by about 10-13 MiB. No additional application-runtime speedup is claimed.

evidence_grades_both.bench_bitmap: C fallback: instruction function arm64.cnt64 in value position

seven_kernel_check.interpretation: Byte identity and unchanged evidence grades, with 10.68% less CPU but 16.82% more elapsed time in this single loaded-host pair. Not evidence of a general elapsed-time improvement; no claim that all seven are proven native.

reproduction: Build benchmarks/native/emit at base_commit and at base_commit plus this commit's allocation-reuse patch, preserving any unrelated work. Later branch changes are outside this measurement.
Store emitters as /tmp/oak-reuse-repeat/emit-before and emit-after in a newly created scratch directory (choose an unused path). Before timing, record emitter and input hashes.

/usr/bin/time -l env OAK_NATIVE_ONLY=hash__blake3_ucompress OAK_VERIFY_CACHE=0 OAK_VERIFY_BUDGET= OAK_OPT_SKIP= OAK_NATIVE_UNROLL_SMALL=0 OAK_NATIVE_LOOP_RESULT_HOMES=0 OAK_NATIVE_TIMING=1 /tmp/oak-reuse-repeat/emit-before benchmarks/kernels/oak /tmp/oak-reuse-repeat/before > /tmp/oak-reuse-repeat/before.stdout 2> /tmp/oak-reuse-repeat/before.log

Repeat sequentially with emit-after / after, emit-after / after2, and emit-before / before2. Keep all other flags equal, do not overlap experiment builds/tests, and compare each .o and .c using cmp and SHA256.

Repeat before then after with OAK_NATIVE_ONLY=bench_dot,bench_sum,bench_search,bench_page_probe,bench_bitmap,bench_dispatch,bench_tiled and distinct seven-before/seven-after prefixes. Preserve and compare evidence grades as well as artifact bytes.
